settings.heading: Open Sole vs Closed Sole — popular questions

settings.question: Which Barreletics are best for reformer Pilates?
settings.answer: Most reformer practitioners prefer the Closed Sole for full underfoot coverage during footbar work. Both styles offer identical 360° grip on reformer carriages.

settings.question: Which Barreletics are best for barre class?
settings.answer: The Open Sole is popular for barre — the barefoot heel connection and mid-foot vent suit the up-on-the-toes, balance-focused nature of barre work.
